title: "rungar providers"
description: "List, inspect, disable and enable providers"
---

List and inspect providers: whether each can be reached, which scale sets are skipping it for finding it full or failing to make their runners, what it says it has spare, and what of Rungar's is on it. Disable, drain or enable one while the daemon runs.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`rungar providers disable`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_disable" >}}) | Take a provider out of placement, leaving its runners to finish. |
| [`rungar providers drain`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_drain" >}}) | Disable a provider, and wait until its runners are gone. |
| [`rungar providers enable`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_enable" >}}) | Put a provider back into placement. |
| [`rungar providers inspect`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_inspect" >}}) | Show one provider: its status and room, the scale sets on it, and its runners. |
| [`rungar providers ls`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/rungar_providers_ls" >}}) | List providers: their status, room, runners and scale sets. |
